name: Lithic and Wood Artisan
core_tasks: Flint percussion and pressure knapping
Shaping handles and hafting adzes and chisels
Building timber sledges and levers
ethical_protection_standards: Mandatory eye protection against flying stone chips
Rotational shifts to prevent repetitive strain injuries
Dust mitigation during dry stone grinding

name: Scribe, Accountant, and Field Surveyor
core_tasks: Calculating field areas and grain volumes
Surveying dyke and canal gradients with plumb-bobs and water levels
Maintaining double-entry inventory and calibration ledgers
ethical_protection_standards: Protection from political retaliation for reporting true accounting figures
Clear transparent audit procedures
Adequate lighting to prevent ocular fatigue

name: Furnace Master and Foundryman
core_tasks: Operating reduction furnaces and controlling draft tuyeres
Preparing refractory crucibles and lost-wax molds
Assaying metal ores and controlling alloy proportions
ethical_protection_standards: Furnace ventilation to prevent carbon monoxide poisoning
Thermal protective aprons and face shields
Strict ban on handling toxic arsenical dust without water-scrubbed hoods

name: Toolmaker and Precision Machinist
core_tasks: Scraping precision surface plates to within optical flatness
Cutting accurate lead screws and slide-rest ways on lathes
Boring steam and pump cylinders to tight tolerances
ethical_protection_standards: Machine guards on exposed gear trains and belts
Noise dampening and ear protection in hammer and machine shops
Fair apprenticeship wages and intellectual property attribution

name: Electrical Systems and Grid Lineman
core_tasks: Winding motor armatures and transformer coils
Testing dielectric insulation with high-voltage megohmmeters
Erecting high-voltage transmission lines and substation breakers
ethical_protection_standards: Lockout-tagout procedures prior to any maintenance
Mandatory insulated arc-flash suits and gloves
Fall-arrest harnesses for high-altitude transmission tower climbing

name: Semiconductor Photolithography and Cleanroom Specialist
core_tasks: Operating high-resolution optical mask aligners and steppers
Managing chemical vapor deposition and plasma etching chambers
Analyzing wafer defect density and four-point probe resistivity
ethical_protection_standards: Positive-pressure cleanroom air scrubbing to filter toxic gases (silane, arsine)
Strict hydrofluoric acid emergency antidote protocols (calcium gluconate gel)
Continuous atmospheric chemical monitoring and alarms

name: Licensed Nuclear Operations Engineer
core_tasks: Monitoring core reactivity balance and thermal-hydraulic margins
Managing control rod maneuvering and scram systems
Supervising spent fuel pool cooling and radiation containment
ethical_protection_standards: Personal thermoluminescent dosimeter (TLD) tracking with strict annual dose limits
Whistleblower legal protection for safety shutdowns
Psychological fitness monitoring and fatigue-limiting shift scheduling

name: Cryogenic Propulsion and Orbital Dynamics Engineer
core_tasks: Assembling and testing high-pressure cryogenic rocket turbopumps
Conducting hot-fire static tests of regeneratively cooled engines
Programming inertial guidance algorithms and orbital trajectory calculations
ethical_protection_standards: Blast-bunker remote test operations with redundant exclusion perimeters
Cryogenic burn personal protective gear (cryo-gloves, face shields)
Strict launch abort safety authority granted to range safety officer

name: Robotics Mechatronics and AI Systems Architect
core_tasks: Tuning real-time closed-loop inverse kinematics and PID servo loops
Integrating LiDAR, stereoscopic vision, and SLAM pipelines
Deploying and fine-tuning deep neural network transformer architectures
ethical_protection_standards: Physical emergency stop buttons within reach of all robotic test cells
Formal ethics board review for any high-autonomy decision system
Transparent auditability of AI inference pipelines
